name: Transplant Test
description: Encounter randomizer in transplant mode, seed 1, on a clean ROM. Every enemy species that appears in a squad is appended as a real creature: the donor's model, portraits, type, innate abilities and its own POW moves, carrying the stats of the slot it replaces. A creature that gains a POW move also gains the POW to swing it, bounded by the donor's own. Nothing else is randomized, so anything odd is this feature.
